subject: ist-pt
title: IST.PT.------INFO.DS.
description: Diagram in WAC-14, on the page where Braxton argues that 'no real understanding of transitional western art music can take place unless the composite reality of its extension is taken into account' — and where Varèse appears as the first to call for electronic instruments, Partch as the cornerstone-of-transformational-pedagogy figure. (C)IST-PT (isolated particulars) is crossed with INFO-DS (information dissemination): the diagram poses what isolated-particulars (Varèse's electronic instruments, Partch's invented apparatus, etc.) actually do when they enter the dissemination apparatus of a culture. IST-PT branches to ALT-D (alternative definitions) → APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions) and ALT-D → AFN (affinity negation); to ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism); to INFO-DS (the crossing); and to IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism). DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) feeds IST-PT and also outputs to CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions). AF-COMP (affinity compression) → MN-DI (mono-dimensional). Structural argument: isolated particulars produced as creative initiations (Partch's instruments, etc.) are routed through alternative-definitions, which split into applied-redefinitions *and* affinity-negation — a forked outcome that captures Braxton's structural worry: even radical isolated particulars get either applied as redefinitions or rejected as affinity-negations. The dynamic-functionalism feed produces cross-transfer definitions as a side output, the very mechanism that Braxton identifies elsewhere as the western redocumentation device.
